about_the_game:
“Howdy, stranger! Ever thought of runnin’ your own supermarket in the wild west one day?
Start here, learn the trade, get to know your customers and who knows - maybe a little later this year you own this place and you’ll be the one behind the counter hiring help. You’ll earn honest pay without riskin’ life or limbs in the mines or on the trail.”



Take over a frontier general store with more potential than customers in the middle of a declining town and bring it back to its former glory.
You are responsible for every aspect of store management, from decoration to furnishing, from stacking the shelves to working the cash register and everything in between.



In this demo to Wild West General Store Simulator, set prices, re-order stock and sell dozens of goods in an ever-changing economic environment with evolving supply and demand - make sure that you make a profit at the end of the day! Don’t forget to relax from a hard day as a shopowner at your home overlooking the town or participate in the local Tomahawk throwing contest.


DEMO FEATURES


  • 25 products to unlock, order, buy, sell and stack your shelves with
  • Various types of shelves, product displays and pieces of furniture/decoration
  • A fully working economic system based on supply and demand
  • Different customers with various needs to satisfy
  • A Tomahawk throwing mini-game with unlockable rewards for your shop
  • Hire a hand to work the till and/or fill your storage
  • Expand your display area and sales floor
  • Random events to challenge your business acumen
  • Freely explore a small frontier town, visit other buildings & shops, interact with townsfolk and potential customers

Note this game is still in active development and the demo will provide a small portion of what to expect in the full release version of Wild West General Store Simulator. Contents and visual quality are subject to change and the demo may be available for a limited time only!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel i5-10400F or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel i5 12400F ~2.5GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended

short_description: Run a General Store in the Wild West. Customize and expand your shop. Make sure that your customers’ constantly changing needs are satisfied. Work every job yourself or let your employees stack the shelves and work the till. Find out what it feels like to own a Wild West Supermarket.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian
